entry.author: Callaghan Innovation
entry.summary: This video is part of the Build to Scale (B2S) series, a capability-building programme designed to support healthtech founders as they move from early traction to scalable growth.Build to Scale focuses on the practical realities of scaling a healthtech company, with expert-led resources, founder insights, and real-world examples across market validation, clinical and regulatory pathways, reimbursement, and quality management.
